mostWorthwhile.text: Powering the atmospheric processor was most worthwhile: it connected the oxygen goal to a clear explanation of extracting oxygen from Martian carbon dioxide.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the array to the reserve was straightforward but less engaging than repairing the damaged equipment.

surprise.text: The reserve supports essential systems but not industrial work, a useful distinction that made the power system feel more grounded.

arbitrary.text: No action felt notably arbitrary; the repairs and connections had clear purposes.

continue.text: Yes. The practical repair details and the first message from Earth make me curious about what the expedition will encounter next.
